subject: Security packet & pen-test timing — Clearwater Health next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: security@clearwaterhealth.com, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Security packet & pen-test timing — Clearwater Health next steps

Hi Samira,

Great demo earlier — thanks for taking the time. As promised, I’m sharing the Redwood security packet (attached) and a short proposal for how we typically coordinate pen tests and vuln management with healthcare customers. High-level items we covered and next steps: 

- We confirm Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II in scope for our inference platform and we maintain GDPR mapping for data flows. I attached the short summary page from our compliance pack.
- You asked whether we can provide a pen test report and the cadence we use for scanning and disclosure. We can — and we want to align the scope and cadence to Clearwater’s requirements.
- Proposed next steps:
  1) You share any vendor security questionnaire (or we can start one — we’ll send an initial completed template).
  2) We propose a two-phase approach: automated scan + remediation window, then an external pen test window (3rd-party).
  3) Agree on disclosure policy and SLA for remediation. Typical Redwood defaults are a 30-day remediation SLA for medium/high findings and quarterly automated scans; formal 3rd-party tests scheduled quarterly or on major releases.

Attachment: redwood_security_packet_v1.pdf (contains SOC 2 summary, data flow map, encryption/KMS details). Also attaching a sample_pen_test_scope.docx that outlines how we run coordinated tests.

Can you confirm: 1) whether Clearwater requires HIPAA-specific attestations on top of SOC 2, and 2) preferred owner for vendor questionnaire and final pen-test scheduling (security@clearwaterhealth.com looks like the right inbox)?

If it helps, we can propose two target windows: prep/automated scan week of May 24, and formal external pen-test window June 7–18. Happy to shift to match your calendar.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_security_packet_v1.pdf, sample_pen_test_scope.docx

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearwaterhealth.com, legal@clearwaterhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-10T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security packet & pen-test timing — Clearwater Health next steps

Thanks Marcus — useful packet, appreciate the quick follow-up. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Clearwater will need HIPAA attestation in addition to SOC 2 evidence; our Privacy team will want the data flow map for PHI scoping.
- I’ve attached our vendor security questionnaire (VSA). Can you fill the technical sections and return? If you prefer, Redwood can initiate the questionnaire in our vendor portal and we’ll grant access.
- For pen test timing, we prefer a formal external test during the June 7–18 window you suggested. We’d also like an initial automated scan the week before (May 24) and a verification scan after remediation.
- For disclosure: security@clearwaterhealth.com for initial triage and legal@clearwaterhealth.com for any public disclosure conversations. We require coordinated disclosure; findings should be routed to security@clearwaterhealth.com first.

Can you confirm the remediation SLA you’re comfortable with and whether Redwood will provide a remediation plan and retest within 30 days of a medium/high finding? Also, please indicate which team members will be our point of contact.

Regards,
Samira Khan
Head of Product Security, Clearwater Health
samira.khan@clearwaterhealth.com

Attachment: Clearwater_VSA_2027.pdf

On May 9, 2027, at 2:02 PM, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Great demo earlier — thanks for taking the time. As promised, I’m sharing the Redwood security packet (attached) and a short proposal for how we typically coordinate pen tests and vuln management with healthcare customers....

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security packet & pen-test timing — Clearwater Health next steps

Hi Samira — thanks, and great to get the VSA. Quick answers and proposed owners: 

- HIPAA: we can provide the additional documentation you need. I’ve flagged our compliance team and will send the PHI mapping excerpt from the packet.
- VSA: Neha (cc’ed) will pick this up and return a completed draft within 3 business days. If you prefer portal access, we can accept an invite to the vendor portal instead.
- Pen-test schedule: we’re aligned on the plan: automated scan week of May 24, formal external window June 7–18.
- Remediation SLA: Redwood proposes a 30-day remediation window for medium/high severity, with a retest/verification scan within 7–14 days after remediation is complete. We’ll provide a remediation plan and classification for each finding. If Clearwater needs shorter SLAs for critical findings we can discuss an escalation path.

I’ve attached the sample_pen_test_scope.docx with the exact tests we typically allow (no destructive tests, coordinated test hours, contact details for emergency callback). Also attaching the Mutual Action Plan (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx) template for signatures and timeline.

Next actions (I’ll own coordination):
- Neha to return VSA answers (due by 2027-05-13).
- I’ll schedule the automated scan May 24 and confirm tooling (SCA + dynamic scans).
- Aditya (cc’ed) will coordinate with our third-party pen tester to lock the June window and provide tester insurance evidence.
- DocuSign link to mutual action plan will be sent after we confirm dates.

On disclosure: we will route findings to security@clearwaterhealth.com and copy legal@clearwaterhealth.com. Public disclosure will only happen with coordinated sign-off.

Thanks — looping the right folks internally.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: sample_pen_test_scope.docx, MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx

> > Thanks Marcus — useful packet, appreciate the quick follow-up....

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Clearwater pen test — SLOs and owners

Neha/Aditya — quick internal note capturing owners and next steps after Samira’s reply. Please treat this as the working checklist and update if anything changes.

Owners:
- VSA owner: Neha Kapoor — complete and return Clearwater_VSA_2027.pdf by EOD 2027-05-13.
- 3P pen test coordination: Aditya Rao — secure tester, collect insurance and rules of engagement (RoE), confirm June 7–18 window by 2027-05-17.
- Evidence & remediation: Neha + InfoSec team — provide remediation plan, assign to engineering contacts, and schedule verification scan within 7–14 days post-remediation.

SLA / cadence we agreed to propose:
- Automated scans: weekly during the prep and remediation phase (May 24–June 4).
- 3rd-party pen test: formal window June 7–18.
- Remediation SLA: 30 days for medium/high (internal target: triage within 72 hours, assign owner within 5 business days).
- Verification scan: within 7–14 days after remediation.

Disclosure: route findings to security@clearwaterhealth.com first. For any critical finding that impacts PHI, escalate directly to Marcus and legal@clearwaterhealth.com.

Docs to send: redwood_security_packet_v1.pdf, sample_pen_test_scope.docx (I attached the edited scope), MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx — send the DocuSign to Samira after Aditya confirms the pen tester.

Notes: keep the pen-test RoE non-destructive and schedule testing windows between 0900–1700 PST unless Clearwater requests otherwise.

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot record (HS-4489) and attach the packet after Neha returns the completed VSA.

Marcus
notes: Thread mixes customer-facing coordination and internal follow-ups; internal participants are limited to marcus_lin, aditya_rao, and neha_kapoor as required.
